title: Free Faith and Leadership Resources | Vertical Life
description: Free tools for Kingdom-minded leaders: The Vertical Framework, Spiritual Fitcheck, creative clarity and stewardship guides, and podcasts on faith and work.

blocks.headline: Grow in wisdom. Lead with purpose.
blocks.body: Free tools, practical guides and podcast conversations to equip you for Kingdom impact in your faith, your work and your leadership.

blocks.heading: Free tools and guides
blocks.body: Proven frameworks and practical guides to help you live with Kingdom purpose every day. Each one is a free PDF.

items.title: The Vertical Framework
items.body: A practical blueprint for living with Kingdom purpose in every area of life.

items.title: Spiritual Fitcheck
items.body: A self-assessment to measure how aligned your life is with God's calling.

items.title: Creative Clarity Checklist
items.body: A simple filter to turn creative chaos into clear, God-aligned action.

items.title: Financial Stewardship
items.body: A Kingdom guide to managing money with margin, purpose and impact.

blocks.heading: Featured podcasts
blocks.body: Conversations with faith-driven leaders, innovators and visionaries pursuing Kingdom impact in every sphere.
